name: The Don Mega Live Resin Badder 1g
description:
Live Resin Badder is a true-to-plant, whipped concentrate with rich aroma and potency.

The badder is produced in Common Citizen’s processing lab by freezing our freshly harvested plants and extracting at -80°F. The final product is smooth and terpene-rich with strong aroma.
--
The Don Mega is an indica dominant hybrid strain that crosses GMO x Black Banana. With strong, long-lasting effects, consumers will feel an initial euphoric boost which gives way to deep relaxation.
---
Common State: Sweet Relief
Feelings: Sleepy, Relaxed, Euphoric
Aroma: Gassy, Earthy, Banana
---
Species: Indica-dominant hybrid
Lineage: GMO x Black Banana
May relieve: Chronic Pain, Stress, Anxiety
Flavor: Gassy, Pungent, Banana
---
Sweet Relief
In Sweet Relief you’ll discover an all-natural alternative that soothes everyday aches and pains. Take it when you wake up to chase away everything from a throbbing head to a sore back, so you can relax completely and make the most of your day.
